# The Spread Sheet

> The Spread Sheet ("Your picks sheet, minus the spreadsheet.") is a free, open-source website for a weekly straight-up game-picks pool among friends, family or coworkers, made by Infinite Visions AI. Anyone can view the board without logging in; players log in with a name and a 4-8 digit PIN to make their own picks, which lock server-side at each game's kickoff. Scores and winners fill in automatically from ESPN's public scoreboard, a custom JSON feed, or manual entry. It runs on a free Cloudflare account (one Worker plus a D1 database, no build step), handles no money, and is not betting.

## Guides

- [README.md](README.md): overview, one-click Deploy to Cloudflare setup in 9 steps, features, recovery, troubleshooting and the developer path.
- [START-HERE.txt](START-HERE.txt): the same setup in plain text at an early reading level, for people who can't open anything else.
- [Setup guide](public/setup-guide.html): picture-by-picture interactive setup guide, also served at /setup-guide.html on every install.
